# Vietnam

> [!summary] Data available
> Vietnam has a few hundred recipes and 44 dishes in each of the main inventories, plus plant data; the FCT and VIETHERB are only in the Backlog. Start with [[RecipeDB2]], [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] and [[WorldCuisines]] (Q1) and [[KNApSAcK Family]] + [[CMAUP]] (Q3).

## Foods & dishes
- [[RecipeDB2]] ≈700 (v1); [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] 351; [[IndicRecipeNutri]] 93 (Indian sites).
- [[WorldCuisines]] 44 dishes (30 Vietnam-only); [[FmLAMA]] 44; [[World Wide Dishes]] 1.
- Not in [[BLEnD]].

## Ingredients & food composition
No FCT processed. [[Vietnamese Food Composition Table]] (print 2017; candidate, priority 2); [[ASEAN Food Composition Database]] (priority 2).

## Compounds & traditional medicine
Traditional Vietnamese medicine: [[VIETHERB]] (herbal species; candidate, priority 3). [[KNApSAcK Family]] 440 records (83 edible / 357 medicinal); [[CMAUP]] 397 plants; [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 91 records; [[NPASS]] 288 pairs; [[Exposome-Explorer]] 22 rows. Global resources without country labels (FooDB, SpiceRx, FlavorDB2, Phenol-Explorer, CTD, HMDB, FoodAtlas, FooDrugs) apply via [[Global]].

## Gaps
No Vietnamese-language recipes, no FCT or traditional-medicine database processed, no BLEnD culture.
